items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bucky, he – what can I tell you?

ctx.x: And they were preverted. Preverts and orgees. That’s quite a movie. You should see it if you ever get a chance.
Bucky, he – what can I tell you?
I forgot that, about orgees. Wow. Back in those days, the fear of being nuked was pretty incredible.
